instructions: Review for logic errors, security vulnerabilities, and violations of the structured rules below. Focus on issues a linter cannot catch — architectural mistakes, missing error handling, incorrect async patterns, and type safety gaps. Do NOT suggest ESLint or Prettier — this project uses oxlint and oxfmt.

rules.rule: NEVER use 'as' to cast types. Type assertions mask real type errors. Use type guards, generic return types, or fix the type definition. Allowed: 'as const' for narrowing, and third-party library boundaries with a comment explaining why.
NEVER use the 'any' type. Use 'unknown' with type guards, generic constraints, or fix the type definition.
NEVER use string parsing (.includes(), .toLowerCase(), regex) to determine types, statuses, or routing. Use typed const objects ('as const' maps) validated at the boundary with Zod schemas.
NEVER use eslint-disable comments. This project uses oxlint, not ESLint. Use 'oxlint-disable-next-line' with an explanation when a targeted disable is needed.
Every Promise must be awaited, returned, or explicitly voided. Unhandled promise rejections crash the process.
Do not use sequential await inside loops (for, for...of, while, .forEach). Use Promise.all() or Promise.allSettled() to parallelize independent async operations.
Use .map(), .filter(), .reduce() over imperative for/for...of loops when transforming data. Imperative loops are acceptable only when early-exit (break/return) is needed.
NEVER reassign function parameters. Create a new variable instead.

Boolean expressions must be strictly boolean. Do not rely on truthy/falsy coercion (e.g., 'if (str)' for strings, 'if (arr.length)' for arrays). Use explicit comparisons: 'str.length > 0', 'arr.length > 0', 'val !== null', 'val !== undefined'.
TypeScript files must not exceed 1000 lines. If a file approaches this limit, split by responsibility.
Do not re-export from files. Import from the source module directly. Barrel files (index.ts re-exports) are prohibited.
Use ?? (nullish coalescing) instead of || for default values. The || operator coerces falsy values (0, '', false) which causes subtle bugs.
Do not nest ternary expressions. Use if/else or early returns for readability.
Switch statements on discriminated unions must be exhaustive. Add a default case that calls a never-returning function or handles all variants explicitly.
Delete dead code immediately. No commented-out code (git has history), no _unusedVar prefixes (remove the variable entirely), no @deprecated annotations for same-branch code.
All if/else/for/while blocks must use curly braces, even for single-line bodies.
NEVER use eval(), new Function(), or setTimeout/setInterval with string arguments. These are code injection vectors.
NEVER hardcode secrets, API keys, tokens, or passwords in source code. Use environment variables or a secrets manager.
Validate all external inputs (API request bodies, query params, webhook payloads) with Zod schemas at the boundary before processing.
